scenario.quote: Name: Return coasters from tables to holder

objects.name: coaster
objects.role: item to be collected and stacked

objects.name: table
objects.quote: Scattered across different tables (coffee table, side tables).

objects.name: coaster holder
objects.role: destination container or surface for stacking coasters

starting_state.fact: Coasters are scattered across different tables.
starting_state.quote: Position: Scattered across different tables (coffee table, side tables).

steps.text: Walk to the table and stand still for 1 second.
steps.quote: 1. Walk to the table and stand still for 1 second.

steps.text: Start with arms in a neutral position. Pick up 1 coaster at a time using a thumb-and-forefinger pinch grip across opposite ends.
steps.quote: 2. Start with arms in a neutral position. Pick up 1 coaster at a time using a thumb-and-forefinger pinch grip across opposite ends.

steps.text: (If walking, otherwise skip if stationary) Walk to the holder or stack spot and stop for 1 second.
steps.quote: 3. (If walking, otherwise skip if stationary) Walk to the holder or stack spot and stop for 1 second.

steps.text: Place the coaster flat on the holder/stack with edges aligned to the coaster underneath.
steps.quote: 4. Place the coaster flat on the holder/stack with edges aligned to the coaster underneath.

steps.text: Gently nudge the coaster into place to adjust alignment.
steps.quote: 5. Gently nudge the coaster into place to adjust alignment.

repeat.end_condition: all coasters are returned to holder or stacked
repeat.quote: Pick up 1 coaster at a time using a thumb-and-forefinger pinch grip across opposite ends.

acceptance.criterion: The coaster is placed flat on the holder or stack.
acceptance.quote: Place the coaster flat on the holder/stack

acceptance.criterion: The edges of the coaster are aligned with the coaster underneath.
acceptance.quote: with edges aligned to the coaster underneath.

constraints.rule: Do not slide coasters off table edges.
constraints.violation_looks_like: A coaster is pushed or dragged over the edge of the table before being lifted.
constraints.quote: Do not slide coasters off table edges.

constraints.violation_looks_like: A coaster is placed askew or jutting out irregularly from the stack without proper alignment.

constraints.rule: Start pickup with arms in a neutral position.
constraints.violation_looks_like: The person reaches for the coaster without first having arms hanging or resting in a neutral position.
constraints.quote: Start with arms in a neutral position.

constraints.rule: Pick up 1 coaster at a time using a thumb-and-forefinger pinch grip across opposite ends.
constraints.violation_looks_like: Multiple coasters are lifted at once, or a coaster is grasped with a full hand wrap rather than a thumb-and-forefinger pinch grip on opposite ends.
constraints.quote: Pick up 1 coaster at a time using a thumb-and-forefinger pinch grip across opposite ends.
